title: Low-degree junta coefficient input row
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. For a frequency $S$ in the low-degree Fourier family on the coordinates outside $P$ and a sequence of restricted assignments of the prescribed restricted sample count, the coefficient input row is the sequence, of length equal to the coefficient sample count, of sign vectors obtained by converting each assignment at its designated sample position for $S$ to the sign cube on the restricted coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: Frequency $S$ in the low-degree Fourier family associated with $P$ and $k$
Sequence of junta-free assignments indexed by the restricted sample count
